why_the_version_string_is_not_enough: `klt --version` reports the package version, which a source build made
after a tag still carries -- so a post-tag build of klayout-tools and the
released v0.6.0 both say `klt 0.6.0` while shipping different decks. The
deck content hash is what tells them apart. This repo's committed evidence
once named a deck hash no release ships (#258) precisely because only the
version string was ever checked, and then only after the fact.
